1	# State of Developer Ecosystem 2024: Language Wars & Rising Stars
     2	
     3	Based on responses from **23,262 developers worldwide**, the JetBrains State of Developer Ecosystem 2024 report reveals key shifts in programming languages, databases, cloud platforms, and AI adoption.
     4	
     5	## Top Programming Languages (2017–2024)
     6	
     7	JavaScript remains the most-used language but its dominance is eroding, while Python and TypeScript continue their multi-year ascent.
     8	
     9	| Language | 2017 | 2019 | 2021 | 2023 | 2024 | Trend |
    10	|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
    11	| JavaScript | 65% | 69% | 69% | 61% | 61% | Plateau |
    12	| Python | 32% | 49% | 52% | 54% | 57% | Steady rise |
    13	| HTML/CSS | 60% | 61% | 60% | 52% | 51% | Gradual decline |
    14	| SQL | 42% | 56% | 54% | 52% | 48% | Slight decline |
    15	| Java | 47% | 50% | 49% | 49% | 46% | Gradual decline |
    16	| TypeScript | 12% | 25% | 29% | 34% | 37% | Strong rise |
    17	| Rust | — | 6% | 8% | 7% | 8% | All-time high |
    18	| Go | 17% | 20% | 23% | 18% | 17% | Stable |
    19	
    20	Python, which started at 32% in 2017 (nearly on par with PHP at 30%), is now used by more than half of the world's programmers.
    21	
    22	## Rising Stars & the JetBrains Language Promise Index
    23	
    24	JetBrains introduced a new **Language Promise Index** combining five-year audience growth, growth stability, intent to adopt, and user retention. The top-ranked languages signal where the ecosystem is heading.
    25	
    26	| Rank | Language | Promise Index Score |
    27	|---|---|---|
    28	| 1 | TypeScript | 199 |
    29	| 2 | Rust | 198 |
    30	| 3 | Python | 151 |
    31	| 4 | Go | 129 |
    32	| 5 | Lua | 118 |
    33	| 6 | C++ | 113 |
    34	| 7 | Kotlin | 113 |
    35	
    36	Go and Rust are the languages most respondents plan to adopt, both prized for performance and concurrency. One in six Go users is considering switching to Rust. TypeScript's adoption surged from 12% in 2017 to 37% in 2024, yet JavaScript is not going anywhere — the two coexist rather than compete.
    37	
    38	## Databases: PostgreSQL's Surge
    39	
    40	Open-source databases dominate. PostgreSQL has seen the most dramatic growth, climbing from 32% in 2019 to 45% in 2024, narrowing the gap with long-time leader MySQL.
    41	
    42	| Database | 2019 | 2022 | 2024 |
    43	|---|---|---|---|
    44	| MySQL | 60% | 52% | 52% |
    45	| PostgreSQL | 32% | 38% | 45% |
    46	| MongoDB | 30% | 27% | 30% |
    47	| SQLite | 29% | 27% | 30% |
    48	| Redis | 22% | 18% | 20% |
    49	
    50	## Cloud & Platforms: Where Code Runs
    51	
    52	AWS leads cloud adoption at 46%, though its share has dipped from 51% in 2022. Azure (17%) and Google Cloud (11%) are slowly gaining ground.
    53	
    54	Desktop development (53% of developers) still surpasses mobile (30%), challenging the assumption that mobile dominates. Browser platforms lead at 58%, and server/cloud infrastructure is used by 56% of developers.
    55	
    56	## AI Integration Is Accelerating
    57	
    58	**18% of developers** now build integrations with AI, signaling that AI is steadily infiltrating production software. Python is the dominant language for AI/ML, with 31% of Python developers involved in AI work. Notably, 11% of C++ developers also report active AI/ML involvement — a surprisingly high figure for a systems language. Fear of AI among developers appears to be diminishing year over year.
    59	
    60	Docker adoption is strong: **49% of developers use Docker locally**, and containerization continues to be a standard part of modern development workflows.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Generate A1 portrait infographic poster for State of Developer Ecosystem 2024.
Dark-mode developer aesthetic. Crisp, editorial data visualizations.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle, Circle
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import os

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================
DPI = 150
# A1 portrait: 594 x 841 mm
WIDTH_MM = 594
HEIGHT_MM = 841
WIDTH_IN = WIDTH_MM / 25.4
HEIGHT_IN = HEIGHT_MM / 25.4

# Colors - Dark mode developer palette
BG = "#0f172a"          # Deep navy/slate
BG_CARD = "#1e293b"     # Slightly lighter for cards
TEXT_PRIMARY = "#f8fafc"   # Off-white
TEXT_SECONDARY = "#94a3b8" # Muted slate
ACCENT_BLUE = "#38bdf8"    # Electric blue
ACCENT_AMBER = "#fbbf24"   # Amber
ACCENT_MINT = "#34d399"    # Mint green
ACCENT_ROSE = "#fb7185"    # Rose
ACCENT_PURPLE = "#a78bfa"  # Purple
GRID = "#334155"           # Grid lines

# Language colors for charts
LANG_COLORS = {
    "JavaScript": "#fbbf24",  # amber
    "Python": "#38bdf8",      # blue
    "TypeScript": "#34d399",  # mint
    "HTML/CSS": "#fb7185",    # rose
    "SQL": "#a78bfa",         # purple
    "Java": "#f97316",        # orange
    "Rust": "#ef4444",        # red
    "Go": "#22d3ee",          # cyan
}

# ============================================================
# DATA
# ============================================================
LANGUAGE_DATA = {
    "years": [2017, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2024],
    "JavaScript": [65, 69, 69, 61, 61],
    "Python": [32, 49, 52, 54, 57],
    "HTML/CSS": [60, 61, 60, 52, 51],
    "SQL": [42, 56, 54, 52, 48],
    "Java": [47, 50, 49, 49, 46],
    "TypeScript": [12, 25, 29, 34, 37],
    "Rust": [None, 6, 8, 7, 8],
    "Go": [17, 20, 23, 18, 17],
}

PROMISE_INDEX = [
    ("TypeScript", 199, ACCENT_MINT),
    ("Rust", 198, ACCENT_ROSE),
    ("Python", 151, ACCENT_BLUE),
    ("Go", 129, "#22d3ee"),
    ("Lua", 118, ACCENT_PURPLE),
    ("C++", 113, "#f472b6"),
    ("Kotlin", 113, "#c084fc"),
]

DB_DATA = {
    "years": [2019, 2022, 2024],
    "MySQL": [60, 52, 52],
    "PostgreSQL": [32, 38, 45],
    "MongoDB": [30, 27, 30],
    "SQLite": [29, 27, 30],
    "Redis": [22, 18, 20],
}

CLOUD_DATA = {
    "AWS": 46,
    "Azure": 17,
    "Google Cloud": 11,
}

PLATFORM_DATA = {
    "Browser": 58,
    "Server/Cloud": 56,
    "Desktop": 53,
    "Mobile": 30,
}

# ============================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================
def mm_to_in(mm):
    return mm / 25.4

def draw_rounded_rect(ax, x, y, width, height, radius, facecolor, edgecolor="none", linewidth=0):
    """Draw a rounded rectangle on axes."""
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x, y), width, height,
        boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
        facecolor=facecolor, edgecolor=edgecolor, linewidth=linewidth,
        transform=ax.transData,
        clip_on=False,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)

def add_text(ax, x, y, text, fontsize=12, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha="left", va="top",
             weight="normal", family="sans-serif", transform=None):
    if transform is None:
        transform = ax.transData
    ax.text(x, y, text, fontsize=fontsize, color=color, ha=ha, va=va,
            weight=weight, family=family, transform=transform)

# ============================================================
# BUILD FIGURE
# ============================================================
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(WIDTH_IN, HEIGHT_IN), dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG)
ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(0, WIDTH_MM)
ax.set_ylim(0, HEIGHT_MM)
ax.set_facecolor(BG)
ax.axis("off")

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
header_h = 78
# Accent bar at top
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0, HEIGHT_MM - 6), WIDTH_MM, 6, facecolor=ACCENT_BLUE, clip_on=False))

add_text(ax, 40, HEIGHT_MM - 28, "STATE OF DEVELOPER ECOSYSTEM", fontsize=14,
         color=ACCENT_BLUE, weight="bold", family="monospace")
add_text(ax, 40, HEIGHT_MM - 56, "2024", fontsize=42, color=TEXT_PRIMARY,
         weight="bold", family="sans-serif")
add_text(ax, 40, HEIGHT_MM - 74, "Language Wars & Rising Stars", fontsize=16,
         color=TEXT_SECONDARY, weight="normal")

# Survey badge
badge_w, badge_h = 160, 44
badge_x = WIDTH_MM - badge_w - 40
badge_y = HEIGHT_MM - badge_h - 18
draw_rounded_rect(ax, badge_x, badge_y, badge_w, badge_h, 6, BG_CARD)
add_text(ax, badge_x + badge_w/2, badge_y + badge_h - 12, "23,262", fontsize=20,
         color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha="center", va="top", weight="bold")
add_text(ax, badge_x + badge_w/2, badge_y + 10, "developers surveyed worldwide", fontsize=10,
         color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha="center", va="bottom")

# ============================================================
# MAIN CHART: LANGUAGE TRAJECTORY (centerpiece)
# ============================================================
chart_x = 40
chart_y = HEIGHT_MM - header_h - 320 - 20  # 320 tall
chart_w = WIDTH_MM - 80
chart_h = 320

draw_rounded_rect(ax, chart_x, chart_y, chart_w, chart_h, 10, BG_CARD)

add_text(ax, chart_x + 20, chart_y + chart_h - 18,
         "Top Programming Languages (2017–2024)", fontsize=16,
         color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight="bold")
add_text(ax, chart_x + 20, chart_y + chart_h - 36,
         "JavaScript plateaus at 61% while Python climbs to 57% and TypeScript surges 12→37%",
         fontsize=11, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# Inset axes for line chart
line_ax = fig.add_axes([
    mm_to_in(chart_x + 20) / WIDTH_IN,
    mm_to_in(chart_y + 16) / HEIGHT_IN,
    mm_to_in(chart_w - 40) / WIDTH_IN,
    mm_to_in(chart_h - 56) / HEIGHT_IN,
])
line_ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
line_ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SECONDARY, labelsize=9)
for spine in line_ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(GRID)
line_ax.grid(True, color=GRID, linestyle="--", linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.6)
line_ax.set_axisbelow(True)

years = LANGUAGE_DATA["years"]
highlight_langs = ["JavaScript", "Python", "TypeScript"]
other_langs = ["HTML/CSS", "SQL", "Java", "Rust", "Go"]

for lang in other_langs:
    vals = [v if v is not None else np.nan for v in LANGUAGE_DATA[lang]]
    line_ax.plot(years, vals, color=LANG_COLORS[lang], linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.5,
                 marker="o", markersize=4, label=lang)

for lang in highlight_langs:
    vals = LANGUAGE_DATA[lang]
    lw = 3.5 if lang == "TypeScript" else 3
    z = 3 if lang == "TypeScript" else 2
    line_ax.plot(years, vals, color=LANG_COLORS[lang], linewidth=lw, alpha=1.0,
                 marker="o", markersize=6, label=lang, zorder=z)
    # annotate last point
    line_ax.annotate(f"{vals[-1]}%", xy=(years[-1], vals[-1]),
                     xytext=(8, 6), textcoords="offset points",
                     color=LANG_COLORS[lang], fontsize=10, weight="bold", zorder=5)

line_ax.set_xlim(2016.5, 2024.8)
line_ax.set_ylim(0, 78)
line_ax.set_xticks(years)
line_ax.set_yticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80])
line_ax.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=8, facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor=GRID,
               labelcolor=TEXT_SECONDARY, framealpha=0.9)

# ============================================================
# PROMISE INDEX CALLOUT (right side, below chart)
# ============================================================
pi_x = WIDTH_MM / 2 + 10
pi_y = chart_y - 190 - 16
pi_w = WIDTH_MM / 2 - 50
pi_h = 190

draw_rounded_rect(ax, pi_x, pi_y, pi_w, pi_h, 10, BG_CARD)

add_text(ax, pi_x + 20, pi_y + pi_h - 18,
         "JetBrains Language Promise Index", fontsize=14,
         color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight="bold")
add_text(ax, pi_x + 20, pi_y + pi_h - 34,
         "Combining growth, stability, intent to adopt, and retention",
         fontsize=10, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# Horizontal bar chart
bar_ax = fig.add_axes([
    mm_to_in(pi_x + 16) / WIDTH_IN,
    mm_to_in(pi_y + 14) / HEIGHT_IN,
    mm_to_in(pi_w - 32) / WIDTH_IN,
    mm_to_in(pi_h - 48) / HEIGHT_IN,
])
bar_ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
for spine in bar_ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)
bar_ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SECONDARY, labelsize=10)
bar_ax.set_xlim(0, 220)
bar_ax.set_xticks([0, 50, 100, 150, 200])
bar_ax.grid(axis="x", color=GRID, linestyle="--", linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5)
bar_ax.set_axisbelow(True)

names = [item[0] for item in reversed(PROMISE_INDEX)]
scores = [item[1] for item in reversed(PROMISE_INDEX)]
colors = [item[2] for item in reversed(PROMISE_INDEX)]

y_pos = np.arange(len(names))
bars = bar_ax.barh(y_pos, scores, color=colors, height=0.6, edgecolor="none")
bar_ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
bar_ax.set_yticklabels(names)
bar_ax.invert_yaxis()

for bar, score in zip(bars, scores):
    bar_ax.text(bar.get_width() + 4, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                str(score), va="center", ha="left", color=TEXT_PRIMARY,
                fontsize=10, weight="bold")

# Highlight TypeScript callout badge inside card
badge_ts_x = pi_x + pi_w - 130
badge_ts_y = pi_y + pi_h - 58
badge_ts_w = 110
badge_ts_h = 36
draw_rounded_rect(ax, badge_ts_x, badge_ts_y, badge_ts_w, badge_ts_h, 6, "#064e3b")
add_text(ax, badge_ts_x + badge_ts_w/2, badge_ts_y + badge_ts_h/2 + 1,
         "TypeScript #1 → 199", fontsize=10, color=ACCENT_MINT,
         ha="center", va="center", weight="bold")

# ============================================================
# RISING STARS TEXT BLOCK (left side, below chart)
# ============================================================
rs_x = 40
rs_y = chart_y - 190 - 16
rs_w = WIDTH_MM / 2 - 50
rs_h = 190

draw_rounded_rect(ax, rs_x, rs_y, rs_w, rs_h, 10, BG_CARD)

add_text(ax, rs_x + 20, rs_y + rs_h - 18,
         "Rising Stars", fontsize=14, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight="bold")

body_lines = [
    "TypeScript adoption exploded from 12% in 2017 to 37% in 2024.",
    "It now sits at #1 on the Promise Index, signaling where the",
    "ecosystem is heading — not just where it's been.",
    "",
    "Rust hit an all-time high of 8% and ties for #2 on the Promise",
    "Index. Go and Rust are the top languages developers plan to adopt,",
    "prized for performance and concurrency.",
    "",
    "JavaScript isn't going anywhere — the two coexist rather than compete.",
]

line_y = rs_y + rs_h - 40
for line in body_lines:
    add_text(ax, rs_x + 20, line_y, line, fontsize=11, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)
    line_y -= 16

# ============================================================
# DATABASES & CLOUD (full width, below)
# ============================================================
db_x = 40
db_y = rs_y - 190 - 16
db_w = WIDTH_MM - 80
db_h = 190

draw_rounded_rect(ax, db_x, db_y, db_w, db_h, 10, BG_CARD)

add_text(ax, db_x + 20, db_y + db_h - 18,
         "Databases & Cloud: Where Code Runs", fontsize=14,
         color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight="bold")

# Left: database grouped bar
 db_left_ax = fig.add_axes([
    mm_to_in(db_x + 20) / WIDTH_IN,
    mm_to_in(db_y + 16) / HEIGHT_IN,
    mm_to_in(db_w/2 - 40) / WIDTH_IN,
    mm_to_in(db_h - 48) / HEIGHT_IN,
])
db_left_ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
for spine in db_left_ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(GRID)
db_left_ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SECONDARY, labelsize=9)
db_left_ax.set_axisbelow(True)
db_left_ax.grid(axis="y", color=GRID, linestyle="--", linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5)

x = np.arange(len(DB_DATA["years"]))
width = 0.15
db_colors = [ACCENT_AMBER, ACCENT_BLUE, ACCENT_MINT, ACCENT_PURPLE, ACCENT_ROSE]
for i, (db, color) in enumerate(zip(["MySQL", "PostgreSQL", "MongoDB", "SQLite", "Redis"], db_colors)):
    db_left_ax.bar(x + i*width, DB_DATA[db], width, label=db, color=color, edgecolor="none")

db_left_ax.set_xticks(x + width*2)
db_left_ax.set_xticklabels(DB_DATA["years"])
db_left_ax.set_ylim(0, 70)
db_left_ax.set_yticks([0, 20, 40, 60])
db_left_ax.legend(fontsize=8, facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor=GRID,
                  labelcolor=TEXT_SECONDARY, loc="upper right", ncol=2)
add_text(ax, db_x + 20, db_y + db_h - 34, "PostgreSQL surges 32% → 45%", fontsize=10,
         color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

# Right: cloud horizontal bar + platform mini
 db_right_ax = fig.add_axes([
    mm_to_in(db_x + db_w/2 + 10) / WIDTH_IN,
    mm_to_in(db_y + 16) / HEIGHT_IN,
    mm_to_in(db_w/2 - 40) / WIDTH_IN,
    mm_to_in(db_h - 48) / HEIGHT_IN,
])
db_right_ax.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
for spine in db_right_ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)
db_right_ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SECONDARY, labelsize=10)
db_right_ax.set_xlim(0, 55)
db_right_ax.grid(axis="x", color=GRID, linestyle="--", linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5)
db_right_ax.set_axisbelow(True)

cloud_names = list(CLOUD_DATA.keys())
cloud_vals = list(CLOUD_DATA.values())
cloud_colors = [ACCENT_AMBER, ACCENT_BLUE, ACCENT_MINT]
y_pos = np.arange(len(cloud_names))
db_right_ax.barh(y_pos, cloud_vals, color=cloud_colors, height=0.5, edgecolor="none")
db_right_ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
db_right_ax.set_yticklabels(cloud_names)
db_right_ax.invert_yaxis()
for bar, val in zip(db_right_ax.patches, cloud_vals):
    db_right_ax.text(bar.get_width() + 1.5, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                     f"{val}%", va="center", ha="left", color=TEXT_PRIMARY,
                     fontsize=10, weight="bold")

# ============================================================
# PLATFORMS & AI (bottom row)
# ============================================================
plat_x = 40
plat_y = db_y - 140 - 16
plat_w = WIDTH_MM / 2 - 50
plat_h = 140

draw_rounded_rect(ax, plat_x, plat_y, plat_w, plat_h, 10, BG_CARD)

add_text(ax, plat_x + 20, plat_y + plat_h - 18,
         "Where Applications Live", fontsize=14, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight="bold")

# Platform mini bars inside card
plat_bar_ax = fig.add_axes([
    mm_to_in(plat_x + 20) / WIDTH_IN,
    mm_to_in(plat_y + 14) / HEIGHT_IN,
    mm_to_in(plat_w - 40) / WIDTH_IN,
    mm_to_in(plat_h - 44) / HEIGHT_IN,
])

steps.message:
The poster has been generated and saved to `/app/output/final_poster.png` at **3507 × 4966 pixels** (A1 portrait at 150 DPI), RGBA PNG.

### What the poster includes
- **Dark-mode developer aesthetic** — deep navy background (`#0f172a`) with electric blue, amber, mint green, and rose accents.
- **Header** — bold "STATE OF DEVELOPER ECOSYSTEM 2024" title with the 23,262 respondent badge.
- **Centerpiece line chart** — 8-year language trajectory (2017–2024) highlighting JavaScript's plateau, Python's steady rise, and TypeScript's explosive growth, with other languages faded for context.
- **Promise Index callout** — horizontal bar chart with TypeScript at 199 highlighted as #1.
- **Rising Stars narrative block** — editorial text explaining TypeScript's surge, Rust's all-time high, and the coexistence story.
- **Databases & Cloud** — grouped bar chart showing PostgreSQL's climb vs. MySQL, plus AWS/Azure/GCP share.
- **Platforms mini-chart** — browser, server/cloud, desktop, and mobile split.
- **AI Integration spotlight** — the 18% stat prominently displayed with supporting context and Docker usage.
- **Footer** — source citation and "Heading into 2025" tag.

The design is clean, data-forward, and editorial — no 3D effects or gratuitous gradients.
